mapper.select: SELECT r.*, p.project_name, p.leader AS leader, (p.budget - COALESCE(p.used_amount, 0)) AS remaining_budget FROM pms_procurement_request r LEFT JOIN pms_project p ON r.project_id = p.id AND p.del_flag = '0' WHERE r.del_flag = '0' AND r.status = 'finish' AND (r.acceptance_status IS NULL OR r.acceptance_status = 'none') ORDER BY r.create_time DESC

SELECT r.*, p.project_name, p.leader AS leader, u.nick_name AS applicant_name, (p.budget - COALESCE(p.used_amount, 0)) AS remaining_budget FROM pms_procurement_request r LEFT JOIN pms_project p ON r.project_id = p.id AND p.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON r.create_by = u.user_id AND u.del_flag = '0' WHERE r.del_flag = '0' AND r.status = 'finish' AND r.acceptance_status = 'done' ORDER BY r.create_time DESC
